summary: Frontend-only Playwright testing of construction.html sections 05-12 (approved copy pass). Verified: no horizontal overflow and zero console/page errors at 1600x1000, 1440x900, 1366x768, 1280x800, 1024x768, 834x1112, 390x844; section 05 (A.01-A.06) and 07 (01-05) activate one-at-a-time forwards AND in reverse with no clipping of the active body inside the reading window (settled measurement) and their closing notes (SEISMIC DETAILING PRINCIPLE / WATER MANAGEMENT PRINCIPLE) fully visible at section end, also on 390x844; section 06 pinned horizontal mapping C.01->Drawing, C.02->Formwork, C.03/C.04->Concrete, C.05->Enclosure, C.06->Completion is exact at every index with cumulative drawing fill correct, and it degrades to a non-pinned vertical list at 1366x768 / 1280x800 / 390x844 with every bullet of all 6 control columns visible and the closing sentence rendered; sections 08-12 render all approved copy (11 register rows TBDY 2018 -> Planli Alanlar Imar Yonetmeligi, 5 acoustic nodes + 4 waveform SVGs, 6 coordination groups, all notes, final title uppercase + 3 paragraphs + Nova Konut signature) with no clipped/zero-height/overflowing text and no >350px blank gaps; MEP tabs all 6 clickable, exactly one active; reload while mid-section 05 and mid-section 06 restores scroll position, pin offset and the correct single active state; regression sections 01-04 still animate. 3 real defects found (all in section 06 / resize determinism).

ui_bugs.issue: The ACTIVE control column is not always fully on screen. At 1440x900 C.01 is cut 51px off the left edge at progress~0.08 and C.06 extends 106px past the right edge at progress~0.77-0.82 (1600x1000: 92px). The column index comes from Math.round(p*(n-1)) while the rail translation is (scrollWidth-innerWidth+40)*p, so a column becomes active before it is fully translated into the viewport; its text is hidden behind the .cx-insp-track mask.

No deterministic first paint: unlike verticalSteps(), horizontalScrub never sets is-on / calls onIndex before the first onUpdate. Observed cols active = [] while the element label strip showed state [0] at the exact section start and after a matchMedia mode switch on resize -> visual state and textual state momentarily unsynchronised (affects section 06 and section 04 concrete rail).

integration_issues.flow: Viewport resize after load (determinism requirement e)
integration_issues.issue: Resizing across a gsap.matchMedia breakpoint (height <= 820px or width <= 1200px, e.g. 1440x900 -> 1440x800 or 1400x900 -> 1150x900) resets window.scrollY to 0 and throws the user to the top of the page. Resizes that do not cross a breakpoint (1440x900 -> 1500x900 / 1440x860 / 1600x1000) keep the position. Not reproducible on about.html or leed.html, so it is specific to the matchMedia revert + document-height collapse in construction.js.

issues: Reveal-on-enter blocks (.cx-idx/.cx-h2/.cx-lbl/.cx-p without .is-in) stay at opacity 0 when they are skipped by a fast/programmatic jump (e.g. jumping straight past the '08 / Envelope' heading + intro). They do reveal when scrolled back into view, so cosmetic only.

action_items: Section 06: tie the active column index to the rail translation (e.g. derive idx from each column's measured offset vs the current translate, or clamp/ease the translate so the active column is always fully inside the track) so C.01 and C.06 are never cut by the viewport edge / mask.

horizontalScrub(): set items[0].classList.add('is-on') and call onIndex(0,0) on creation (mirroring verticalSteps) so the pinned section is never blank / desynced at the section start and after a matchMedia switch.

Preserve scroll position when a matchMedia breakpoint is crossed on resize (capture scrollY/progress before the revert and restore it after ScrollTrigger.refresh) instead of jumping to the top of the page.
critical_code_review_comments: js/construction.js horizontalScrub: index (Math.round) and translation (linear progress) are two independent sources of truth for the same state - the root cause of the active column being partially off screen; make position the single source.
js/construction.js: gsap.matchMedia revert on breakpoint crossing changes document height by ~12k px with no scroll restoration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Approved copy integrity verified via /app/scripts/cx_verify_0512.py (227 lines OK). Sections 05/07 state tracking, 06 mapping/vertical fallback, 08-12 content completeness, MEP tabs, mid-section reload recovery and no-overflow/no-console-error checks all PASS. Re-test after fixes: (1) active column fully on screen through the whole S06 scrub at 1440x900 and 1600x1000 (measure col rect vs innerWidth at >=64 sample points), (2) an active column exists at the exact section start and immediately after a resize across the 820px-height / 1200px-width breakpoints, (3) scrollY preserved across such a resize. Note when measuring clipping in S05/S07 use >=600ms settle after each scroll step - collapsible bodies animate and short waits produce false 4-10px bottom-cut readings. Known pre-existing out-of-scope items: .cx-flow-stage (04) ~13px taller than 900px viewport, section 03 rows on short viewports, section 02 last row on 390px.
rca_of_the_issue: S06 off-screen active column: horizontalScrub computes idx = round(progress*(items.length-1)) but positions the rail with translate = (rail.scrollWidth - innerWidth + 40) * progress; because the columns are wide (432px) the rounding boundary is reached before/after the corresponding column is fully inside the track, so the first and last columns are highlighted while still partly outside the masked viewport. Scroll reset on resize: crossing the gsap.matchMedia queries ((max-width:1200px),(max-height:820px)) reverts the pinned/horizontal setup, document height drops from ~50k to ~39k px and no scroll position is captured/restored around ScrollTrigger.refresh, so the browser lands at 0.
